No bridge

Guide readers never see you teach live

Cold applications

Why this class exists

Most body image advice skips one step.

  • Plenty of people have heard “just love your body” and found it didn’t stick.
  • Many put plans, photos and trips on hold, waiting for the right time.
  • A comment, a fitting room or an old photo can bring it all back.
  • Almost nobody is told that grief is a normal part of the process.

Here’s what you’ll learn

What we’ll cover together

What body grief is, and why naming it matters

The idea at the heart of Bri’s work, and why it changes how the rest of the process feels.

Why “just love your body” so often stalls

Why jumping straight to positivity can leave people stuck, and what tends to help instead.

Reassessing self-talk

One of Bri’s 7 steps: noticing the inner commentary and choosing what to do with it.

Needs in body image work

Another of the 7 steps: what support actually looks like, day to day.

How to keep going after the class

Simple next steps, plus live Q&A with Bri.

Before you save your seat

Is this therapy?

No. It’s an educational class. It isn’t therapy or medical advice and doesn’t replace one-to-one support from a licensed professional.

Is this about changing my body?

No. This class is about the relationship with your body. There are no diets, plans or body goals here.

What if I can’t make it live?

Everyone who registers gets the replay.

Why is it free?

Because the first step should be easy. Come, listen, and decide afterwards if you want to go deeper.

Script 1 · “Nobody mentioned grief”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Here’s the part of body image work nobody talks about.”

Body

“It’s grief. For the plans that were put on hold. For the years spent waiting. Most advice skips straight to ‘love yourself’, and that’s often why it doesn’t stick. Grief has steps, and it can be moved through.”

CTA

“I’m teaching my 7 steps in a free live masterclass. Tap Sign up to save a seat.”

Shot: talking to camera, same warm setup as your reels. Caption line: Educational content, not medical advice.

Script 2 · “Why positivity stalls”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Why ‘just love your body’ advice so often stops working.”

Body

“As a counselor and body image coach, I see the same pattern. People are told to jump to positivity, then feel like they’re failing when the old feelings come back. That’s not failing. That’s grief asking for space.”

CTA

“In The Body Grief Masterclass I’ll walk through what to do instead. It’s free and live. Tap Sign up.”

Shot: talking to camera, on-screen text “grief asking for space” with coral highlight.

Script 3 · “Self-talk”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“One of my 7 steps for body grief takes five minutes a day.”

Body

“It’s reassessing self-talk. Not forcing nice thoughts. Just noticing the commentary and asking where it came from. It’s step 2 of 7, and it’s one we’ll practise together.”

CTA

“Join me for the free live masterclass. Replay included. Tap Sign up below.”

Shot: talking to camera, cut to a slide listing step 2. Podcast clip optional.
